paper_title: Revisiting the bound on axion-photon coupling from Globular Clusters
notes: Astrophysical bound from R parameter of 39 Galactic Globular Clusters. Main result: g_agamma < 0.66e-10 GeV^-1 at 95% CL (benchmark, low-Z HII region He abundance). Bound applies for axion mass below ~keV (Primakoff production in stellar core). Best-fit g_agamma = 0.45e-10 GeV^-1 (68% CL). Mass-independent bound across wide range; representative mass points chosen to span the validity range (~10^-10 eV to ~keV). Alternative bounds: SBBN <0.50e-10, solar Y <0.76e-10 GeV^-1. Not a DM haloscope, so no DM density assumed. | Auto-corrected masses: MHz→eV (×4.136e-09, rule=argmin|log10(median*f)-log10(anchor=1.0e-05)|)
